## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour; no existing test was weakened
- [ ] Schema changes include a generated migration
- [ ] API changes are noted in the changelog
- [ ] Touches payments, tax, pricing, access control, auth or secrets (needs a second reviewer)
- [ ] No code copied from OroCommerce or other copyleft projects
